title: Yin and yang show in how a pole appears in its domain (2026-10-23)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Lets do a bit of prep for this pole setting. Lets work through the domains with their poles. (some from the srs compass and should have clear yin/yang attribution.) When we place an axis in a context we can normally recognise yin and yang by how they appear in the domain. General attributes: Yang / yin; thing / relation; movement / stillness; Outward / Inward; assertive / reflective; forward looking / Retrospective
